==Notes==
*When timed correctly this skill [[synergy|synergizes]] well with [[Meteor Shower]] in [[Player versus Environment|PvE]], as enemies generally fail to spread out before the first packet of Meteor Shower [[damage]] (and knock down) hits.
*The animation for this skill was not changed since its area of effect size changed from nearby to adjacent. The [[Area of effect |AoE]] range of this ability therefore looks larger than it actually is.

==Trivia==
*The [[functionality]] of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Bed of Coals/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
